metadata.name: Rotating Cover Art
metadata.description: Adds circular mask to cover art and rotation

files.index.css: @keyframes rotating {from {transform: rotate(0deg);}to {transform: rotate(360deg);}}.cover-art, .main-nowPlayingView-coverArtContainer::after, .main-nowPlayingView-coverArtContainer::before {animation: rotating 10s linear infinite;border-radius: 50%;}.cover-art {clip-path: circle(50% at 50% 50%);} .main-nowPlayingBar-left button {background: transparent;} .main-nowPlayingView-coverArt {box-shadow:none; filter: drop-shadow(0 9px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.271));}
